title: Video Pacing
description: Controlling information rate and cut frequency so attention, comprehension, and emotion stay aligned with runtime.
summary: Video pacing is the temporal design of shot length, scene duration, and information density that shapes how quickly a viewer processes story and persuasion.

definitions: Video pacing is the temporal design of shot length, scene duration, and information density that shapes how quickly a viewer processes story and persuasion.
rules: If viewers must read text, hold long enough for comfortable reading.
Always slow down on the product's key proof beat.
When retention falls, cut earlier—do not add more decoration.
Never pace a corporate explainer like a hyperactive social trend cut unless intentional.
bestPractices: Vary pace: accelerate through low-information moments, breathe on proof moments.
Let on-screen text and voiceover dictate minimum readable duration.
Front-load retention for ads; allow measured pacing for explainers.
Use cut frequency as emphasis, not as default decoration.
